description: This file defines the default theme for CKEditor, including functions for building the editor interface, managing shared spaces, resizing, and handling theme spaces. It also includes methods for building dialogs and destroying theme elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.theme
classes.description: Defines the default theme for CKEditor, including methods for building the theme UI, dialogs, and managing shared spaces.

methods.name: checkSharedSpace
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the shared space container element for the editor.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main editor theme interface, including spaces for top, contents, and bottom.

methods.name: buildDialog
methods.description: Constructs the dialog UI for the editor.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the theme container and cleans up references.
